podcast.title: First CD Test Pressing (1979)
podcast.body: A recording of the Berlin Philharmonic, conducted by Herbert von Karajan, performing Richard Strauss' "An Alpine Symphony," was chosen as the first test pressing CD. This recording appeared in 1979 and was selected for its exceptional clarity and wide dynamic range, qualities the compact disc technology promised to deliver. "The first test pressing, a CD used to demonstrate the new technology, was a recording of the Berlin Philharmonic, conducted by Herbert von Karrihan, performing Richard Strauss' and Elpine Symphony. This appeared in 1979, and this recording was chosen for its clarity and wide range of dynamics, something that the compact is promised."
